subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the public focused gateway ReDoS fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411, or route this report through private security handling first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the affected path handles model-supplied media URLs on a stable gateway runtime surface and can stall the event loop, so automation should not choose the disclosure/security route.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: Proceed with the open focused parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the public handling path and validation semantics.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause the public PR path and handle the denial-of-service report through the repository security process before landing a fix.

recommendation.title: Land after security-aware review
recommendation.body: Proceed with the open focused parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the public handling path and validation semantics.
